private void validateSignatureReference(Signature signature, String expectedId) throws WSSecurityException {
    if (signature == null) {
        throw new WSSecurityException(...);
    }
    if (signature.getSignedInfo() == null) {
        throw new WSSecurityException(...);
    }
    List<Reference> refs = signature.getSignedInfo().getReferences();
    if (refs.size() != 1) {
        throw new WSSecurityException(...);
    }
    Reference ref = refs.get(0);
    String uri = ref.getURI();
    if (uri == null || !uri.equals("#" + expectedId)) {
        throw new WSSecurityException(...);
    }
}
